title: Taweez against Migraine
data:
Put your hand on the aching half of your head and repeat the following supplicatory prayer three times:
يَا ظَاهِرًا مَّوْجُوْدًا وَّ يَا بَاطِنًا غَيْرَ مَفْقُوْدٍ اُرْدُدْ عَلٰى عَبْدِكَ الضَّعِيْفِ اَيَادِيَكَ الْجَمِيْلَةَ عِنْدَهٗ وَ اَذْهِبْ عَنْهُ مَا بِهٖ مِنْ اَذًى اِنَّكَ رَحِيْمٌ قَدِيْرٌ
YAA ZAAHIRAN MAWJOODAN WA YAA BAATINAN GHAYRA MAFQOOD, URDUD A'LAA A'BDIKAD DA'EEFI AYAADIYAKAL JAMEELATA I'NDAHU WA AZHIB A'NHU MAA BIHI MIN AZAN INNAKA RAHEEMUN QADEER
O You Who are Manifest yet Present, O You Who are Hidden yet not Absent, restore to Your weak servant Your beautiful favors, and remove from him whatever harm he suffers; verily You are Merciful, All-Powerful.
